scripts.architecture:check: corepack pnpm --filter @learning-more/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @learning-more/architecture build && node tools/architecture/dist/check-architecture.js
scripts.benchmark: corepack pnpm --filter @learning-more/server build && corepack pnpm --filter @learning-more/benchmarks build && corepack pnpm --filter @learning-more/benchmarks benchmark
scripts.ci:local: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm verify && corepack pnpm supply-chain:check
scripts.playwright:runtime: corepack pnpm --filter @learning-more/server build && playwright test --config playwright.runtime.config.ts
scripts.release:portable: corepack pnpm verify && corepack pnpm --filter @learning-more/release build && node tools/release/dist/build-portable.js
scripts.supply-chain:check: corepack pnpm --filter @learning-more/release build && corepack pnpm --filter @learning-more/release policy:check
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @learning-more/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm schema:check && corepack pnpm architecture:check && corepack pnpm equivalence:check && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
